verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own CLI documents creating releases, associating commits with a release (auto-discovered from git) and recording deployments, so the release and commit linkage exists. Nothing in the evidence shows an issue displaying the release it first appeared in, or any suspect-commit attribution. missing for 10: per-issue first-seen release display, suspect-commit identification on issues, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can associate errors with releases and commits so each issue shows the release it first appeared in and the suspect commit that likely caused it

citations.quote: Associate commits with a release (auto-discovers from git)
Record deployments for a release: glitchtip-cli deploys new 1.0.0 --env production --org my-org --project my-project
